fail.answer: GitHub does not redeliver automatically; you can redeliver deliveries from the past 3 days.
Per the page, redelivery is manual.
GitHub doesn't retry deliveries that failed to reach your server; redeliver from Recent Deliveries. Automatic redelivery is not available.
Deliveries are dropped when your endpoint is unreachable; you cannot access them after three days.
